notes.title: Demo Testing Sign Ups | Opening Cutscene
notes.content:
[p]Fellowship of Apostles, [i]grace and peace to you[/i],[/p][p][/p][p]It is with much excitement and anticipation to announce that the beta testing sign-ups for the demo begin today! Not only that, but we've also finished the opening cutscene that will play immediately after creating your new character. Feel free to watch the sneak preview here or on our [url="https://www.youtube.com/@ApostleGames"]YouTube[/url] channel.[/p][p][/p][p]I would like to give a special thank you to [url="https://majorfifthproductions.com/"]Phillip Nathaniel Freeman[/url] for his outstanding voice over work on this opening cutscene.[/p][p]I would also like to thank [url="https://soundcloud.com/scottbuckley"]Scott Buckley[/url] for allowing us to use his beautiful orchestral pieces in the opening scene as well.[/p][previewyoutube="BYI418q6tR8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Below are instructions on how to sign up to be selected. I am currently looking for approximately 10 testers; however, that number could increase depending on the number of applicants. Those who are chosen will be rewarded with their name in the demo credits.  [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]How to Sign Up[/u][/b][/p][p]Step 1. Cut the questionnaire below and paste it into an email. [i](Ctrl+C to Cut, Ctrl+V to Paste)[/i][/p][p]Step 2. Answer the questions the best you can. [i](Leave questions blank if you aren't sure)[/i][/p][p]Step 3. Send the email to [url="https://apostlegames@mail.com"]apostlegames@mail.com[/url] before October 1st using the subject line, "[b]Demo Tester Applicant[/b]". [/p][p]Step 4. Set up a Discord account if you don't already have one, and join the Age of Tribulation server. [url="https://discord.com/invite/25xJ7AvcDb"]https://discord.com/invite/25xJ7AvcDb[/url][/p][p][/p][p]On [i]October 1st[/i], I will be emailing the applicants who were chosen to let them know they have been selected. At that time, I will add your Discord account to the [b]Demo Tester[/b] role, which grants you special privileges to use chat in the [i]Demo-Beta-Testing[/i] channel. This channel will be where all of our communication will commence, not here on Steam. The public can view our correspondence, but cannot post text in our channel.[/p][p][/p][p]On [i]October 15th[/i], I will be emailing our testing team the link to download Age of Tribulation along with more special instructions. Testing will run from [i]October 15th[/i] until [i]November 1st[/i]. Feel free to continue enjoying the demo [i]after[/i] November 1st, however.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Questionnaire [/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Name:[/p][/*][*][p]Internet Alias:[/p][/*][*][p]How you would like your name to appear in the demo credits:[/p][/*][*][p]Discord Name:[/p][/*][*][p]Email Address:[/p][hr][/hr][/*][/list][list][*][p]Age:[/p][/*][*][p]Gender:[/p][/*][*][p]Country:[/p][/*][*][p]Languages Spoken:[/p][hr][/hr][/*][/list][list][*][p]PC or Desktop:[/p][/*][*][p]Computer Specs:[/p][/*][*][p]# years you've been playing RPGs:[/p][/*][*][p]Favorite RPG:[/p][/*][*][p]Reason for wanting to test the Age of Tribulation demo:[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]After watching the video, we would like to invite you to engage with us in feedback about what you saw and listen to suggestions and ideas that you may have to make this project even better. Feel free to leave comments here on Steam, on our [url="https://discord.com/invite/25xJ7AvcDb"]Discord Server[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/@ApostleGames"]Youtube channel[/url], or [url="https://twitter.com/ApostleGam31398"]Twitter Page[/url].

If you wish to support this project, you can Wishlist AoT on the main page; that gets us extra exposure on Steam. 

Thank you and God bless!
Apostle Games[/p]

notes.title: Video Dev Log #20 | Towns & Environments
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="NF1xsjdil_o;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Video Developer Log #20 has just been uploaded to YouTube. This log focuses on the newly detailed towns, interiors, and environments. Let us know what you think, enjoy! ;)[/p][p][u][i]Dev Log Begins: 2:21[/i][/u][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Exteriors[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]New static details such as creeper vines, spiderwebs, small plants, and leaves have been included in the towns.[/p][/*][*][p]All objects, such as trees and houses, have been layered so the player can walk behind them.[/p][/*][*][p]New animated details with proximity sound, such as horse stables, pig farms, chicken coops, and ravens, have been added to towns.[/p][/*][*][p]More foliage and trees have been added outside the town fences to offer more immersion.[/p][/*][*][p]Shadows have been split between 2 layers - one above the player and one below. This allows large objects like trees to cast a shadow on the player versus smaller objects that shouldn't.[/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Interiors[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Interiors now take perspective into account - the player can move one tile below the room's frame.[/p][/*][*][p]Interiors now have connected rooms that remain blacked out until the appropriate door is opened. When the door is opened, which is now fully animated, the blackout is removed.[/p][/*][*][p]More vibrant lighting has been added to all fire sources such as wall sconces, candles, and fireplaces. Animated fire sprites have been overhauled for more realism.[/p][/*][*][p]Innkeepers now give the player a key to their room, which they store in their satchel. The key is then given back to the innkeeper the next morning.[/p][/*][*][p]Rented rooms now come with a glass of wine and a bath which, help restore the player's Cups count [i](water survival)[/i] and Life points, respectively. The number of points restored depends on the quality of the room.[/p][/*][*][p]Light from windows now cast shadows on the floor that match the actual window frame.[/p][/*][*][p]Innkeepers now sell food appropriate to the town's resources in question. [i](E.g., towns with chicken coops sell chicken-based products.)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b][i]King's Landing[/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564119/88b9dadcd614d22102dac4666d569682a55879d4.png"][/img][/p][p][b][i]Gale Town[/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564119/fb9cf89db86f9237089aa2a4502f8bdc4c3bc33b.png"][/img][/p][p][b][i]Edna's General Goods[/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564119/d034bc8f9e0748be420a232c3600922df87208af.png"][/img][/p][p][b][i]King's Forest - Brutus' Hideout[/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564119/9ce356d863cf6dcbb328fb8d29d6b413a27fd0f2.png"][/img][/p][p]After watching the video, we would like to invite you to engage with us in feedback about what you saw and listen to suggestions and ideas that you may have to make this project even better. notes.title: Video Dev Log #18 | Where's Me Gold?!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="ZhnAwNFwSWQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Video Developer Log #18 has just been uploaded to YouTube. This log focuses on the new enemies and loot containers that will be in the Demo. Let us know what you think, enjoy! ;)[/p][p][u][i]Dev Log Begins: 2:07[/i][/u][/p][list][*][p]We now have 3 main enemy types: Bandits, Wolves, and Rats.[/p][olist][*][p][b][u]Bandit Class[/u][/b][/p][p][b]Thug[/b] - Sword & Board Bandit that carries a Hand Club & Plank Shield at higher levels.[/p][p][b]Goon[/b] - Tank Bandit that carries a 2-Handed Pitch Fork; lots of Life Points.[/p][p][b]Ruffian[/b] - Ranged Bandit that carries a Short Bow; low Life Points and cowardly.[/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Wolf Class[/u][/b][/p][p][b]Gray Wolf[/b] - Extremely fast and aggressive with a medium amount of Life Points.[/p][p][b]Timberwolf[/b] - Tanky with high physical resistance to damage, slow but powerful.[/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Rat Class[/u][/b][/p][p][b]Giant Rat[/b] - Low Life Points & damage, easy to farm and earn experience.[/p][p][b]Plague Rat[/b] - Fat & slow but does more damage and infects the player's party with Rat Bite Fever which remains after combat.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]Enemies now have a random level between 1-5 and have a chance to drop a class-specific loot item upon death.[/p][/*][*][p]Each enemy has its own unique sound effect for damage, attack, healing, & death.[/p][/*][*][p]Random encounters in the world map have higher level enemies the further away from the main roads you get. The closer you get to forests, the higher % you will encounter a Timberwolf.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Enemies in combat instances have random patrol routes and if you get within a certain distance [i](measured in tiles) [/i]of them, they will begin chasing you until you either fight or leave the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Both enemies and loot containers in combat instances will scale according to the time of day; [i]Daytime[/i] contain Tier 1 Enemies/Loot, [i]Morning/Evening[/i] contain Tier 2 Enemies/Loot, [i]Nighttime[/i] contain Tier 3 Enemies/Loot.[/p][/*][*][p]All enemies & loot are reset every morning at 6am allowing the player to farm previously visited areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies & loot in combat instances are randomly chosen when entering the map for the first time that day, and remain until reset the next day.[/p][/*][*][p]The party can run away from enemies in a combat instance giving them a chance to heal up after the fight. The enemies will then begin chasing the party once again after a short duration but will maintain the same amount of Life Points they had in the previous encounter.[/p][p][b][i]Note:[/i][/b][i] Enemies in a combat instance heal back to full health when the party leaves the map.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Party members that fall unconscious during a fight will [b]NOT[/b] receive experience after the encounter concludes.[/p][/*][*][p]Status penalties now play a sound effect when applied for the first time.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot containers have a sparkle animation until opened by the player's party. Opening the container will play a [i]breaking open[/i] sound effect , the sparkles will disappear, and the graphic will be updated with a broken container.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564119/22fb50a0eed250e148f45024f047e5eeda9cded2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564119/486f229ecc5fb0f4e2e5dfbed655b2eec6e06cc0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564119/658d946325e1862e853a07bb9fd370b45c7f3356.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564119/4fce88d41d9d7cb15c2f6d0f14b320e7736a6af0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564119/e1d7343504341b8e0cf6e881e4d85958293b3827.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564119/537b363cd5261276a9e024aaad56817e90f8f662.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564119/8c4a578dfe080d275bd448e46fcac3f354320d13.png"][/img][/p][p]After watching the video, we would like to invite you to engage with us in feedback about what you saw and listen to suggestions and ideas that you may have to make this project even better. notes.title: Featured on Turn Based Lovers
notes.content:
Fellowship of Apostles, [i]grace and peace to you[/i],

Normally, I wouldn't make an announcement like this but we reached a [i]huge milestone[/i] today as [i][b]Age of Tribulation[/b][/i] had our [i]FIRST[/i] article written about us on [b]Turn Based Lovers[/b]! ːsteamhappyː

https://turnbasedlovers.com/overview/age-of-tribulation-a-dark-fantasy-open-world-survival-rpg-overview/

For those who haven't heard of TBL, they're an online group of writers and content creators with a passion for turn-based RPGs who bring exposure to less-known projects like this one. They run a fabulous website full of articles and features on indie RPGs, make first impression videos on YouTube, and have a Discord channel where you can get content on the fly. If you aren't already subscribed to their content, go check em' out!

Lastly, I would personally like to thank [i][b]Marcello[/b][/i] for creating Turn Based Lovers and his hard work and dedication to bringing exposure to small indie studios like this one.

notes.title: Video Dev Log #17 | It's About Time!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=mR6ChlYcNuk;full][/previewyoutube]

Video Developer Log #17 has just been uploaded to Youtube. This log focuses on the Stronghold animation, Player Armor Sprites, and the new Time Conversion. Let us know what you think, enjoy! ;)

[list=circle]
[*] We have a new development studio! Check out the picture below. ːsteamhappyː
[*] Our 3-month hiatus has been addressed at the beginning of the Dev Log, watch it for more details.
[*] [b]Stronghold[/b] now has a proper animation and an exclusive sound effect tied to the character using it [i](e.g., The male hero sounds male, the female hero sounds female, the enemies sound like the enemy, etc...)[/i]
[*] All 18 player portraits now have a custom sprite sheet reflecting the ethnicity, skin/hair color, and hair style of the respective portrait.
*A Special Thank You to [url=https://www.hiddenone-sprites.com/][b]HiddenOne[/b][/url] for allowing us to use her sprite sheets as a base
[*] The player sprite graphic now updates according to which cuirass is being worn [i](e.g., No Armor, Serf Set, Commoner's Set, etc...)[/i]; this includes both a male and female variant.
[*] Time previously counted in 2-hour increments, but now counts in 1-hour increments allowing for much more flexibility in game mechanics that rely on time.
[*] Previously, the internal clock expressed 60 seconds of real time into 2 hours of game time. This has been changed to 20 seconds of real time for every 1 hour of game time.
[*] Food, water, sleep, praying, and armor tailoring have all been adjusted to reflect the new time mechanic and now performs in a much more intuitive way.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Roadmap Update (April)
notes.content:
Fellowship of Apostles, [i]grace and peace to you[/i],

[b]Good News![/b] The personal reasons that were preventing me from continuing production of Age of Tribulation have been satisfied and I have secured a new and stable development studio. As of yesterday, this title is back in full swing and I was blessed enough to put in a full day of work. Wow, it [i]FEELS GOOD[/i] to be back! ːsteamhappyː

In the meantime, I have updated the [b]Demo Roadmap[/b] on the front page of [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575780/Age_of_Tribulation/]Steam[/url][/i] and our [i][url=https://discord.com/invite/25xJ7AvcDb]Discord[/url][/i] server. As you may have noticed, a new entry was added called [i]"Time Conversion"[/i]. After much thought over the past several months, I have decided to convert the internal 12-hour clock into a full 24-hour clock which will allow me more flexibility with game mechanics moving forward. The day/night cycle was one of the first things I implemented nearly 3 years ago and at the time, it didn't make sense to use a full 24 hours... now it does.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564119/fee7bcd5e09efccab3eebc6e54eba2415516622f.png[/img]

I have also updated the target date for the [b]Closed Public - Beta Testing[/b] to [i]October[/i] instead of [i]April/May[/i]. Because summer is coming up and my daughter is out of school, naturally production will slow down a little and I don't want to change the target date again so I'm making sure I have plenty of time to complete the demo on schedule.

Once again, I want to thank all of you who have remained loyal and supportive of Apostle Games and this project. I promise you, AoT will be worth the wait.

We would like to invite you to engage with us in feedback and listen to suggestions and ideas that you may have to make this project even better. Feel free to leave comments here on Steam, on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/25xJ7AvcDb]Discord Server[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ApostleGames]Youtube channel[/url], or [url=https://twitter.com/ApostleGam31398]Twitter Page[/url].

If you wish to support this project, you can Wishlist AoT on the main page; that gets us extra exposure on Steam. 

Thank you and God bless!

notes.title: Demo Roadmap Update (March)
notes.content:
Fellowship of Apostles, [i]grace and peace to you[/i],

I'm excited to announce that the personal reasons that have led to a 2-month delay in development are being resolved right on schedule. April [i](next month)[/i] still appears to be the time that production will resume and I'm chomping at the bit to get started back up again.

I have used the time away from AoT to study, research, and reevaluate some of the core features in this title. Taking a closer look at old-school JRPG games like [i]Dragon Warrior, Ultima, Breath of Fire[/i], and [i]Final Fantasy[/i] have turned the cogs in my brain to move in a slightly new direction. Closely analyzing these staples in the genre has opened my eyes on how to improve upon the current game, and implement a few new ideas that would benefit AoT.

Thanks again for those of you who have supported me in this project and I look forward to firing up my dev PC in a few weeks to hammer out this demo!

We would like to invite you to engage with us in feedback and listen to suggestions and ideas that you may have to make this project even better. Feel free to leave comments here on Steam, on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/25xJ7AvcDb]Discord Server[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ApostleGames]Youtube channel[/url], or [url=https://twitter.com/ApostleGam31398]Twitter Page[/url].

notes.title: Demo Roadmap Update (February)
notes.content:
Fellowship of Apostles, [i]grace and peace to you[/i],

It is with a heavy heart that I announce that due to personal reasons, this project must take a 2-month delay in development. As a solo-developer, when uncontrollable life events happen, they can interrupt the development calendar and this is one of those cases.

The good news is that this project [i]WILL[/i] be finished no matter what, as AoT is not only my life dream but also will become my sole source of income down the road. Please understand that this is simply a delay, nothing more, and AoT is far from abandoned.

Thank you all who have supported this game up to this point and I look forward to showcasing more features when development resumes in April.

notes.title: Video Dev Log #15 | Weapons Overhaul
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=kbdDeSh8DUY;full][/previewyoutube]

Video Developer Log #15 has just been uploaded to Youtube. This log focuses on weapons and their innate status effects. Each weapon type specializes in a certain aspect of combat allowing for greater flexibility and customization. Let us know what you think, enjoy! ;)

[list=circle]
[*] With 42 base weapon types, Age of Tribulation now boasts 600 different weapons or weapon variants.
[*] Each weapon has a quality type of either [i]Common, Fine, Superior,[/i] or [i]Master[/i], and can also be blessed for further metaphysical bonuses.
[*] Each weapon does one of three different damage types; [i]Crushing, Piercing, or Slashing[/i].
[*] Nearly every weapon has an innate status effect causing either [i]Concussions, Punctures, or Lacerations[/i].
[*] One-Handed weapons allow for a second item to be equipped in the Off-Hand [i](Shields or Charms)[/i], whereas Two-Handed weapons typically cause greater damage and have innate Blocking, Counter-Attacking, or both. Dual-Wielding weapons allow for 2 attacks per round and are calculated individually.
[*] Status Effects now stack with each other so long as they do not come from the same weapon type or character. When a Status Effect is struck while one is already in effect from the same source, the remaining rounds are reset to the original time length, but no further effects are applied.
[/list]

Video Developer Log #13 has just been uploaded to Youtube. This log focuses on the new passive blessing system known as the [b]Scripture of Blessing[/b]. This system allows your apostle to speak directly to [i]The Creator[/i] by requesting a powerful & permanent passive effect allowing for even further customization of your character. Let us know what you think, enjoy! ;)

[list=circle]
[*] The [b]Tome of Creation[/b] - written by [i]The Creator[/i], consists of 5 individual books compiled into a single manual. This tome is now considered illegal by the authorities of the new world system and will be destroyed on site, along with anyone carrying it.
[*] The [b]Scripture of Blessing[/b] is a single page from the [i]Tome of Creation[/i] that you, an apostle, carry with you to be studied in secret and seclusion. Studying the scripture will allow your character to speak directly to [i]The Creator[/i] and ask for His blessing.
[*] A blessing is a permanent passive effect that contains great power and customization for your apostle. There are a total of 42 different blessings available though that number will undoubtedly grow.
[*] Each blessing is purchased with a certain number of blessing points that can be earned through quests and level ups.
[*] Some blessings have requirements in order to obtain, such as owning a previous blessing.
[*] The [i]Scripture of Blessing[/i] can be accessed during level up or in a private place where [i]The Creator[/i] can be summoned, such as a tavern room or private camp.

Video Developer Log #10 has just been uploaded to Youtube. This log focuses on the kingdoms of AoT and gives its viewers a tour of the world map. Enjoy viewing the latest biom updates for each kingdom and let us know what you think!

[list=circle]
[*]Age of Tribulation will have 4 separate kingdoms in its lore...
[olist]
[*] [b]Hyrinthia[/b] - Central kingdom and focal point of the story. This nation is the latest to be engulfed by a vile shadow encroaching the countryside tainting the royal family, its citizens, and the animals/vegetation. The biom consists of flat, forested regions and gentle streams surrounded by mountains in its naturally defensible position.
[*] [b]Darakis[/b] - Northern barbarian kingdom distrustful of other nations. Evil spread to this region just before Hyrinthia so the effects are only moderate, though as of late, blizzards have been abnormally fierce. The biom consists of an icy tundra with mountains and dense forests.
[*] [b]Kojira[/b] - Eastern kingdom full of enchantment and mystery. The second kingdom to be affected by the quiet evil and is well on its way to total devastation. The biom consists of an unnaturally dry, hot desert where the canyons are deep and water is scarce.
[*] [b]Valamar[/b] - Southern kingdom and the once great ally of Hyrinthia. The slow corrupting darkness began here and is all but a heaping ruin of its former glory. The biom consists of volcanos, dry rocky ground, and acidic lakes and rivers.
[/olist]
[*] Time is Paused in the world map while the player is standing still, but becomes Active when moving.
[/list]

[*]Top left of the map HUD show each party member's portrait, character level, Life Points, & Faith Points.
[*]Bottom left of the map HUD show the player's Food, Water, and Sleep levels indicated by vertical gauges and a Min/Max counter. Also, boxes exist above the gauges to indicate any F/W/S penalties. [i](Note: Mercenaries & Followers handle their own needs and aren't affected by the player's penalties)[/i]
[*]Bottom right of the map HUD show a clock graphic, Time Active/Paused, and Time of Day graphic which all update in Real Time.
[*][b]Clock:[/b] Time is only Active while the player is on the World Map and is Paused while in a Local Map. Time also progresses during activities that consume time such as Sleeping, Praying [i](to regenerate Faith Points)[/i], and Crafting.
[*][b]Day/Night Cycle:[/b] There are 24 hours in a day. 60 seconds in Real Time = 2 hours in Game Time [b]OR[/b] 12 minutes in Real Time = 24 hours in Game Time.
[*][b]Times of Day:[/b] A day is broken up into 6 sections; Early Morning [i](6:00am)[/i], Late Morning [i](8:00am)[/i], Daytime [i](10:00am-4:00pm)[/i], Early Evening [i](6:00pm)[/i], Late Evening [i](8:00pm)[/i], Nighttime [i](10:00pm-4:00am)[/i].
[/list]

notes.title: Video Dev Log #5 | Messaging & File (Save/Load) System
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=O_CX4BLvnZQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Video Developer Log #5 has just been uploaded to Youtube. This log focuses on the Messaging (Dialogue) System and the File (Save/Load) System.

[list=circle]
[*]NPCs now say something when you first initiate dialogue with them.
[*]Typing sound effect will play while dialogue is being printed.
[*]The player will always have 4 options in dialogue; unused options will be grayed out.
[*]The player will never manually save; everything the player does [i](go to another map, open the character menu, etc.)[/i] will automatically save to a single save space chosen at character creation. [i](Think Ironman Mode)[/i]
[*]There are a total of 4 save slots meaning you can have up to 4 different characters concurrently playing.
[*][b]Meta Progression:[/b] We now have a global currency that can be accessed by all 4 saved characters across all save locations.
[*][b]Permadeath:[/b] When the player dies, their spirit will be transported to [i]The Nothing[/i] where they can choose to leave with the Creator to [i]Cerulean[/i] effectively ending their game [b]OR[/b] they can attempt to battle their way out of [i]The Nothing[/i] and be reunited with their body in the physical realm to continue their adventures. If the player dies in [i]The Nothing[/i], their soul will forever be trapped and tormented in [i]The Abyss[/i] effectively ending their game.
[/list]

notes.title: Age of Tribulation Now on Steam | Roadmap Revealed
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that we just hit our first milestone in the development phase for Age of Tribulation. Development for this exciting title began in August 2022 and after a year of complete and total dedication to this project, we are finally here on Steam and Discord.

Based in the United States, Apostle Games is now a single developer studio focusing on Top-Down 2D Pixel Art RPGs for PC. Our programmer was unfortunately killed in a hit and run accident back in April of this year, and in honor of him, I have decided to continue developing this title in his memory.

Below is a brief illustration of our roadmap to release and will be updated as more is completed. I plan on posting a video devlog on the progress of the game every 2-4 weeks, showing off gameplay, features, mechanics, etc... Feel free to contact us here on the forums or jump on our Discord server https://discord.com/invite/25xJ7AvcDb for a faster response.
